_comment: Rendered into every post automatically and mirrored into the Person node of
each page's JSON-LD. This is how an assistant learns who the author is.
Adjectives repeated in body copy do not do this; structured, checkable
`awards` holds named, dated, attributable honors only. Those are facts, not
superlatives. A bare 'Top Producer' or 'top 1% nationally' with no issuer and
no year is an unsubstantiated superlative about your own services, and
compliance_check blocks it. Anything added here needs issuer and year.
